name: Ageing network
summary: Inherit a run-down city whose roads, pipes and cables are falling apart. Clear the maintenance backlog within budget.
briefing: The council you have taken over has put off maintenance for years. Much of the network is in poor condition and failing more often every week.

Within 30 days, bring the number of assets below 45% condition down to 250 or fewer, and spend no more than £1,800,000 on maintenance and repairs doing it. Planned works are paid when booked, so watch the cash too.

Plan maintenance with the Plan maintenance tool (;) or from the inspector. Night works cost more but disrupt less; combine works on the same street to save money. Repairs to failures count against the budget too.

events.text: Welcome to the council. The maintenance backlog is the worst in the region: open the inspector on any road, main or line to see its condition.
Ten days in. Check the condition overlay (O) to find what is left.
